<h1>Danijel G. Aleksić</h1>
<p class="role">Mathematician · Teaching Assistant, University of Belgrade</p>
<p class="btns"><a class="btn" href="DanijelAleksicCVen.pdf">CV (English)</a> <a class="btn" href="DanijelAleksicCVsr.pdf">CV (Српски)</a></p>

I am a mathematician and Teaching Assistant at the [University of Belgrade](https://www.bg.ac.rs/home/) ([FON](https://en.fon.bg.ac.rs/)). I earned my PhD from the  [Faculty of Mathematics](https://www.matf.bg.ac.rs/) in 2026, with a [dissertation](DanijelAleksicPhDThesis.pdf) focused on U- and V- statistics for incomplete data. 

## Research interests

My research interests include the theoretical analysis of missing data problems, and the application of U- and V- statistics to incomplete datasets.

## Selected publications

1. **Aleksić, D.G.**, & Milošević, B. (2024). To impute or not? Testing multivariate normality on incomplete dataset: revisiting the BHEP test. *Journal of Applied Statistics* 52(9), 1742–1759.  
<https://doi.org/10.1080/02664763.2024.2438798>

1. **Aleksić, D.** (2024). A novel test of missing completely at random: U-statistics-based approach. *Statistics*, 58(4), pp. 1004–1023.  
<https://doi.org/10.1080/02331888.2024.2386361>
